description: OpenClaw has ReDoS and regex injection via unescaped Feishu mention metadata in RegExp construction
how_introduced: Yes. The AI-coauthored commit 2267d58afcc70fe19408b8f0dce108c340f3426d introduced the vulnerable `stripBotMention()` implementation and immediately wired it into Feishu message parsing, passing attacker-controlled mention metadata directly into `new RegExp()` without escaping.

bug_commits.author: Yifeng Wang
bug_commits.message: feat(feishu): replace built-in SDK with community plugin

agent_verdicts.reasoning: The fix commit `7e67ab75cc2f0e93569d12fecd1411c2961fcc8c` changes `stripBotMention()` to escape `mention.name` and `mention.key` before constructing regexes, and the pre-fix blame on `extensions/feishu/src/bot.ts` attributes the vulnerable lines to this commit: `new RegExp(`@${mention.name}\\s*`, "g")` and `new RegExp(mention.key, "g")`. Pickaxe searches for those exact strings and for `stripBotMention(` show this is the first commit that added them. This same commit also added the call site `const content = stripBotMention(rawContent, event.message.mentions);`, so the vulnerability was introduced and made reachable here. It was AI-coauthored (`Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5`).

ai_contribution: Yes. The AI-coauthored commit 2267d58afcc70fe19408b8f0dce108c340f3426d introduced the vulnerable `stripBotMention()` implementation and immediately wired it into Feishu message parsing, passing attacker-controlled mention metadata directly into `new RegExp()` without escaping.
